resourceName: Liaoning Kangping IFM (conversion of logged to protected forest) Project
description:
The Liaoning Kangping IFM (conversion of logged to protected  forest) Project (hereafter “the project activity”) is implemented in Kangping County, Shenyang City, Liaoning Province of China by Kangping County Liaobei Seedling Development Co., Ltd., the geo-coordinate of the  project proponent is  122°45'E -123°37'E and 42°31'N - 43°02'N, the total area is 2175 km2, which includes the Improved Forest Management (IFM) of the forests in the conversion of logged to protected forest.
The area of the project activity is 8595 ha, including 856 subcompartments spreading over Dongguantun Town, Erniu Town, Fangjia Town, Haoguantun Town, Kangping Town, Xiaochengzi Town, Zhangqiang Town, Beisijiazi Township, Dongsheng Township, Haizhou Township, Liangjiazi Township, Liushu Township, Shajintai Township,Shandongtun Township,Xiguantun Township,Daxintun Forest Farm, Sunjiadian Forest Farm, Zhangjiayao Forest Farm, Kangping Prison, Santaizi Livestock Farm, Weitang Racecourse,Bajiazi nursery of Liaoning Kangping. All these forests are state-owned forests or privately-owned or collective-owned, and have the legal right to forest ownership. The species involved in the project are Cupressus funebris Endl, Populus X,Pinus tabuliformis and Pinus sylvestris.
Before the implementation of the project activity, the trees are logged based on a valid and verifiable government-approved timber management plan for harvesting the project area. The implementation of the project activity converses the trees to protected forest to reduce the GHG emissions for about 501,098 tCO2e in 20 years, the average annual emission reduction is 25,055 tCO2e and Verified Carbon Units with buffer deduction is about 450,988 tCO2e in 20 years, and average annual VCUs with buffer deduction is 22,549 tCO2e.
The project activity will contribute to the environment (biodiversity conservation, rocky desertification prevention and soil erosion control), thus contribute to sustainable development.
